verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs list milestones and due dates among its issue features, so grouping issues into milestones is a documented first-party capability. The evidence is only a single feature-list mention, and it ties due dates to issues rather than explicitly to milestones. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that milestones themselves carry due dates, detail on milestone management (creating milestones, assigning issues, tracking progress), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group issues into milestones with due dates

citations.quote: Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.
